program.name: Section 301 — Brazil country action
program.detail: Additional 25% ad valorem on products of Brazil, except headings 9903.05.02–9903.05.09. Stacks with other Ch.99 additional duties in the same subchapter (including 301-FL 9903.05.27 from 2026-07-24).

exemptions.notes: Loaded/in transit before 2026-07-22 and entered before 2026-07-29 (ocean).
Annex HTS list under U.S. note 50(a)(ii) — claim-gated until annex stem pack is loaded.
Specified products (etrogs, acai, religious goods, etc.) under note 50(a)(iii).
Civil aircraft and related parts / simulators.
Aluminum, steel, copper/derivatives, passenger vehicles & parts, MHDV & parts, wood products, semiconductors — Section 232 universe.

sources: CSMS #69302472 — GUIDANCE: Section 301 Duties on Certain Products from Brazil
